```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6, tidy = TRUE)
```

1. Transects were filtered to only include broadcast burning, wildfire, or Untreated points.

Note: Incomplete transects (those with thinning-only points filtered out) were allowed in the dataset. 

2. Six models were constructed for different combinations of starting severity and transect Type:

Low x Entering, Moderate x Entering, High x Entering
Low x Exiting, Moderate x Exiting, High x Exiting

3. The model formula is:

RdNBR ~ Type + Treated + (1|Incid_Name/Transect_ID)

Where Type = control or entering/exiting & Treated = Untreated or broadcast/wildfire


```{r prep, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggeffects)
library(brms)
library(here)
library(performance)
library(sjPlot) #Table of model outputs

transects <- st_read(here("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "transectsDS") 

#Create factors for random effects and categorical variables
transects$Event_ID <- factor(transects$Event_ID)
transects$Incid_Name <- factor(transects$Incid_Name)
transects$TransectID <- factor(transects$Transect_ID)
transects$Type <- factor(transects$Type, levels = c("control", "entering", "exiting"))

transects$Trt_Type[is.na(transects$Trt_Type)] <- "Untreated"
transects$Treated <- factor(ifelse(transects$Trt_Type == "Untreated", "No", "Yes"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))

#Drop geometry
transects <- st_drop_geometry(transects)
```

# Jones Dataset

```{r, results = 'asis'}
#Filter for only Broadcast Burning or Wildfire
jones_df <- transects %>%
  filter(!Trt_Type %in% c("Rearrangement", "Removal")) 
```

## Transects by Type in each Fire and Starting Severity

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Build abbreviation lookup once, outside the pipe
fire_abbrevs <- jones_df %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  distinct(Incid_Name) %>% 
  arrange(Incid_Name) %>% 
  mutate(abbrev = abbreviate(Incid_Name, minlength = 3)) %>% 
  tibble::deframe()  

jones_df %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(Starting_Sev, Incid_Name, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    n = n / 10,
    Starting_Sev = factor(Starting_Sev, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = c("control", "entering", "exiting")),
    Incid_Name = fire_abbrevs[Incid_Name]  # swap to abbreviation before pivoting
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Incid_Name,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Starting_Sev, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = rowSums(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric)))
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::group_split(Starting_Sev) %>% 
  purrr::iwalk(~ {
    cat("\n\n###", as.character(unique(.x$Starting_Sev)), "\n\n")
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        dplyr::select(.x, -Starting_Sev),
        format = "pipe"
      )
    )
  })


# Print the key once, after all three tables
cat("\n\n**Key:**", paste(names(fire_abbrevs), fire_abbrevs, sep = " = ", collapse = "; "), "\n\n")
```

## Entering Datasets

```{r}
# Filter by Trt_Type to only include broadcast or wildfire
enter_df <- jones_df %>%
  filter(Type != "exiting")

enter_df$Trt_Type <- factor(enter_df$Trt_Type, levels = c("Untreated", "Broadcast Burn", "Wildfire"))
enter_df$Type <- factor(enter_df$Type, levels = c("control", "entering"))

enter_df_low <- enter_df %>%
  filter(Starting_Sev == "Low")
enter_df_mod <- enter_df %>%
  filter(Starting_Sev == "Moderate")
enter_df_high <- enter_df %>%
  filter(Starting_Sev == "High")

par(mfrow = c(3, 1))
hist(enter_df_low$RdNBR, breaks = 30,
     main = "Low Starting Severity Transects (Entering)", 
     xlab = "RdNBR", 
     ylab = "Frequency")
hist(enter_df_mod$RdNBR, breaks = 30,
     main = "Moderate Starting Severity Transects (Entering)", 
     xlab = "RdNBR", 
     ylab = "Frequency")
hist(enter_df_high$RdNBR, breaks = 30,
     main = "High Starting Severity Transects (Entering)", 
     xlab = "RdNBR", 
     ylab = "Frequency")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}

exit_df <- jones_df %>%

```

# Entering Models

### Low Entering Model

```{r}
enter_fit_low <- lmer(RdNBR ~ Type + Treated + (1|Incid_Name/Transect_ID), data = enter_df_low, REML = TRUE)

tab_model(enter_fit_low)

# Residual diagnostic plots for m1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Q-Q plot
qqnorm(resid(enter_fit_low), main = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(resid(enter_fit_low), col = "red")

# Residuals vs Fitted
plot(fitted(enter_fit_low), resid(enter_fit_low),
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Entering Effect

```{r}
# Extract population-level predictions (averaged over random effects)
pred_low  <- ggpredict(enter_fit_low,  terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "Low") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

pred_mod  <- ggpredict(enter_fit_mod,  terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "Moderate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

pred_high <- ggpredict(enter_fit_high, terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "High") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

# Combine, drop the non-existent control+Treated combination,
# and relabel x-axis categories
pred_all <- bind_rows(pred_low, pred_mod, pred_high) %>%
  filter(!(x == "control" & group == "Yes"))

pred_all$severity <- factor(pred_all$severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))

# Plot
ggplot(pred_all, aes(x = x, y = predicted, group = group, shape = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted RdNBR"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## For GSS Abstract, percent drop in severity when high severity fire enters a Treated area

```{r}
pred_high_df <- as.data.frame(pred_high)

pred_high_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(x, group, predicted, conf.low, conf.high)

# Replace "entering" with whatever your non-control level of `Type` is called
ent <- pred_high %>% filter(x == "entering")

p_Untreated <- ent$predicted[ent$group == "No"]
p_Treated   <- ent$predicted[ent$group == "Yes"]

abs_drop <- p_Untreated - p_Treated                      # RdNBR units
pct_drop <- (p_Untreated - p_Treated) / p_Untreated * 100
c(abs_drop = abs_drop, pct_drop = pct_drop)
```

### Exiting Effect

```{r}
# Extract population-level predictions (averTrt_Yeard over random effects)
pred_low2  <- ggpredict(exit_fit_low,  terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "Low") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

pred_mod2  <- ggpredict(exit_fit_mod,  terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "Moderate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

pred_high2 <- ggpredict(exit_fit_high, terms = c("Type", "Treated")) %>%
  mutate(severity = "High") %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted))

# Combine, drop the non-existent control+Treated combination,
# and relabel x-axis categories
pred_all2 <- bind_rows(pred_low2, pred_mod2, pred_high2) %>%
  filter(!(x == "control" & group == "Yes"))

pred_all2$severity <- factor(pred_all2$severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))

pred_all2$group <- factor(pred_all2$group, levels = c("Yes", "No"))

# Plot
ggplot(pred_all2, aes(x = x, y = predicted, group = group, shape = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted RdNBR"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
